description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'MediaContentObserver' that manages content observation for media changes, handles permission requests, and provides UI controls to schedule or cancel media-related background jobs.

classes.name: MediaContentObserver
classes.description: An Android Activity that observes media content changes and manages related jobs, including permission handling and UI updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up content observer, binds UI controls, and registers the observer.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of runtime permission requests to read external storage.

methods.name: updateButtons
methods.description: Enables or disables UI buttons based on the schedule state of media and photo jobs.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters the content observer when the activity is destroyed.
